children: RNS Number : 0076D  DFS Furniture PLC  13 November 2026
DFS Furniture plc (“DFS Group” and the “Group”)
AGM Trading update for 19 weeks ended 8 November 2026
Maintaining leadership through subdued market demand
DFS Furniture plc (the ‘Group’), the market leading retailer of upholstered furniture in the United Kingdom, provides the following update in advance of its Annual General Meeting later today.
Current trading, market conditions and our response

At our full year preliminary results on 24 September 2026, we reported that Group order intake over the first 12 weeks of FY27 was -2.5% year on year which was in line with our expectations, reflecting the weak consumer backdrop.

Over the subsequent seven weeks, upholstery market demand has softened further, reflecting continued pressure on household budgets and reduced consumer confidence. The Group has not been immune to this climate, but proprietary banking data1 indicates that our core retail brands, DFS and Sofology, have continued to outperform the wider sector, reflecting the strength and resilience of the Group.

We are investing to support customers in this challenging environment with targeted commercial initiatives to drive conversion as we enter key trading periods of Black Friday and our Winter Sale, whilst maintaining rigorous discipline across our cost base.

Against a backdrop of fluctuating footfall, fragile consumer confidence, and the early stage of our financial year, full-year profit expectations naturally carry a wider range of potential outcomes. We will provide a further update as part of our half year trading statement on 21 January 2027.

As highlighted at our FY26 results, unlocking additional space through mezzanine expansion represents an attractive, low risk driver of long term growth in our non-upholstery Home proposition. Following the launch of our fifth mezzanine at our DFS Leeds Birstall showroom in October, early customer response has been encouraging and the showroom is trading in line with our expectations. This provides further validation for our expansion strategy in this key adjacent market.

“While the consumer environment has remained challenging through the autumn, DFS is well placed within it as the clear market leader with unmatched scale, brand resonance and operational strength. As we enter the important upcoming trading periods, we are focused on what we can control; taking proactive commercial actions to drive cash margins while maintaining tight control of our costs. Our proven model and strategic progress give us confidence in the Group’s resilience through the cycle and our ability to deliver long term value for all shareholders.”
1 Proprietary Lloyds banking data covering 14 specialist upholstery retailers
